block.title: cresting the cloud deck
block.positive: Majestic storm boss reveal in widescreen arcade key art, the SQUALL STEED, a fortress-sized mechanical seahorse rearing up out of a roiling grey-violet cloud deck, its long snouted head plated in cold steel-blue with a mane of loose tensioned cables streaming sideways in the gale, segmented neck rings creaking open as its chest armor falls away on heavy hinges exposing a swirling captive thunderhead glowing white-blue inside the ribcage cage, coronet spikes along the back lifting sheets of rain, a curled counterbalance tail vanishing into cloud below, saw-tooth snow ridges of a mountain range cutting the lower background under slanting silver rain streaks, a tiny steel-blue dart fighter with orange exhaust climbing the updraft at the left edge for scale, lightning forking between the mane cables, deep navy storm shadows never pure black, SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, ultra-detailed large-format art with pixel texture accents, subtle CRT scanline glow, no text.
